title: Hockey great Wayne Gretzky defends relationship with President Trump and speaks on Russian hockey ban
summary: Wayne Gretzky spoke about his friendship with President Trump and Canada's decision to ban Russia from the World Junior Hockey Championship in Alberta.

title: Trump names Stephen Miller new White House chief of staff, replacing Susie Wiles
summary: Susie Wiles served 21 months as Trump's longest-serving chief of staff across both terms, departing after Republicans lost the House and Senate. Trump announced Stephen Miller will take on the role.

title: Progressive group's 182-page blueprint maps out potential Dem investigations into Trump, corporate allies
summary: Former President Joe Biden aides mapped Tesla, Apple, Amazon and OpenAI as targets for sweeping Democratic congressional investigations into Trump allies.

title: Trump admin sues Penn State over in-state tuition policy for undocumented migrants
summary: The DOJ's lawsuit accuses Pennsylvania State University of offering undocumented students in-state tuition rates that discriminate against U.S. citizens.

title: Federal judge temporarily blocks construction of Trump's Arlington triumphal arch hours after approval
summary: The National Capital Planning Commission had approved construction for President Trump's proposed triumphal arch in Washington, D.C., hours before the restraining order was issued.

title: Vance ‘privately’ blasts Netanyahu as Iran war divides Trump administration and 2028 ambitions loom
summary: JD Vance privately accused Benjamin Netanyahu of being "wrong on everything" about the Iran war as he positions himself for a 2028 presidential bid.

title: Trump signs proclamation to prevent changes to Oval Office, other White House rooms
summary: Trump signed a proclamation designating the Oval Office and Cabinet Room a national monument to prevent future presidents from altering them.

title: Reporter's Notebook: A user’s manual to upcoming leadership elections in the House and Senate
summary: Capitol Hill leadership elections pit Hakeem Jeffries against progressive dissent, while Steve Scalise and Jim Jordan battle for GOP minority leader.

title: Chicago Bears and NFL reopen talks with Illinois leaders to keep franchise from moving to Indiana
summary: Roger Goodell and George McCaskey met with Illinois leaders as legislation to keep the Chicago Bears from relocating to Hammond, Indiana, takes shape.

title: Alzheimer's warning signs could emerge years before memory loss, study finds
summary: A Science Advances study reveals how brain scan connectivity patterns predict Alzheimer's disease years before memory loss or cognitive decline.
